nom: Dr. Brandt Oxygen Facial Glow Revitalizing Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask does not add to dryness and instead leaves their skin looking less dull, feeling repaired, or noticeably softer, including one who says it helped restore a skin barrier compromised by retinol.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who states she has combination skin reports a real difference specifically in the dull areas of her face.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no stinging, itchiness, redness, or breakouts, with only one describing a mild tingling sensation that she attributes to her skin being unusually sensitive rather than to the product being harsh.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers who mention dryness — including several who describe their own skin as dry — consistently report the mask leaves skin hydrated, soft, and refreshed without tightness or stripping; none in this set describe it as drying, even one dealing with retinol-related dryness and a compromised barrier.
concerns.redness: The reviewer who describes her skin as sensitive and prone to redness reports the mask calmed her skin and significantly reduced redness; another reviewer with sensitive skin reports no redness, itchiness, or stinging at all. One reviewer whose skin type isn't stated noted slight irritation around the nose, which she attributes to applying the product too close to that area.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions a compromised skin barrier — from retinol use — says this mask is one of the few products that has actually helped repair and smooth her skin.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who mentions dark spots says they appeared slightly faded after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin or a history of breakouts say the mask did not irritate their skin or cause new breakouts; none in this set describe it treating existing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers note the mask removes excess oil without stripping the skin, and one adds that it did not make her skin oily.
concerns.aging: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry and aging reports the mask leaves it fresh, soft, hydrated, and brighter; a couple of other reviewers separately mention a firming or plumping effect after use, without stating their skin type.

aspects.libelle: Foams and bubbles into a spa-like sensation
Rinses off clean with no sticky residue
Attractive bottle with a metered pump
Seen as worth the price despite cost

extraits.texte: complimentary from drbrandt. I had never heard of Dr. Brandt or the oxygen facial before receiving this item. The mask is easy to apply and wash off and it bubbles and foams up on the skin. It has a pleasant "crackling" feeling, but I haven't noticed a difference in my skin after using it for 2 weeks.

I've been using this oxygen facial in the mornings, especially on days when I know I'll be busy, and it has quickly become part of my routine. My skin is naturally very sensitive and gets red easily, so I wasn't expecting such a noticeable difference. After using it, my skin looked calmer, the redness was significantly reduced, and my complexion felt fresh and brighter. I do experience a slight tingling sensation while the oxygen is activating, but that's most likely because my skin is extremely sensitive and I don't tolerate even mild discomfort very well. I don't think this would bother the average person. What I really appreciate is how quick and easy it is to use. The lightweight gel texture feels nice, and after just a few minutes you simply rinse it off. It's a lot more convenient than masks that need to stay on for a long time. For me, the results definitely make it worth using. gifted by drbrandt

gifted by drbrandt. I have dry skin and when I haven't been getting good sleep or hydration, it shows on my skin. I have loved incorporating this mask into my routine. I exfoliate twice weekly and I love using this right after I do a physical exfoliant. It really revives and refreshes my skin. It is gentle and does not irritate my acne-prone skin. I also enjoy using this after long work shifts (I am a nurse and my skin gets extra dry and irritated at work) or after travel days. It's a little extra pampering that leaves my skin looking renewed. I always look forward to using this one! The foamy bubbles make it feel like a spa treatment.

I received this product complimentary from Dr. BRANDT This mask is very easy to apply and definitely feels like a spa experience. It is a foaming mask that feels very pleasant on the skin as the bubbles form; it is gentle enough for daily use yet delivers highly effective results. I've noticed a real difference, especially in the dull areas of my combination skin, which can sometimes look tired. The best part is that it starts working within seconds of the very first use.

I had never tried an oxygen mask before, but now it'll be part of my weekly skincare routine. It's easy to apply/remove, and leaves my face feeling super refreshed. I had trouble with dry skin and a broken skin barrier from using retinal. This is one of the few products that has actually helped repair and smooth my skin. Can't wait to keep using it! complimentary from drbrandt

Complimentary from Dr. BRANDT This oxygen facial mask is great. I got brighter skin after the first use. It's easy to use and works fast, instant gratification. I want to use this from head to toe. It was slightly irritating around my nose, I may have out it too close, otherwise no issues. I love it and will definitely be using again and again.

complimentary from drbrandt I really like this oxygen mask from Dr Brant. My skin feels little bit firmer and some dark spots can be seen faded slightly. The process is quick and I only need to leave the mask on for 5 minutes. Very good for someone who does not have time for skincare routine like me
